name: shinchantw_cbt_no_ad_purchase_full_day_v2_20260729_185026_512964
sql:
WITH tc_blacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
), sg_blacklist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
), sg_country AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'
), tc_android AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'
), sg_android AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'
)
SELECT 'TC Android, 102901' AS cohort, MIN(v."#event_time") AS first_purchase_time,
  COUNT(*) AS purchase_orders,COUNT(DISTINCT v."#account_id") AS buyers
FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN tc_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id
WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND v."$part_event"='charge' AND b.user_id IS NULL
  AND CAST(TRY_CAST(v.product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=102901
  AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox=FALSE) AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy=FALSE)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SG Android, 102901',MIN(v."#event_time"),COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT v."#account_id")
FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id
WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND v."$part_event"='charge' AND b.user_id IS NULL
  AND CAST(TRY_CAST(v.product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=102901
  AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox=FALSE) AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy=FALSE);
